1.context: But wait a minute, when he made man, he already had the plan for not only the sinfulness of man, but for the salvation of man. It was all encompassing planned out. In Ephesians chapter 1, we have another scripture that says the same thing. Ephesians 1, verse 3. Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ, just as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world. Wait, I'm chosen, you're chosen in Christ before the foundation of the world, which would be before Adam, right?
